//: Declaration-bundling config used ONLY by tsup's dts build (see tsup.config.ts). It maps the internal @streetui/* specifiers to their SOURCE entry points so rollup-dts resolves every shared type (e.g. StreetApp) to a SINGLE declaration instead of pulling each internal package's pre-bundled .d.ts (which would emit duplicate, nominally-incompatible copies and break consumers like `compile(streetui.app(...))`). rootDir is intentionally omitted here because the source graph spans sibling packages; the JS build uses esbuild and the type-check uses tsconfig.json (which keeps rootDir).
